metadata.title: Offer Intelligence — Listing & Unpublish Verification
systems: IQS Catalog API (OFFER, PRODUCT, PRICE, LOGISTICS, OSCAR, SI)

intake.input_format: 32-character alphanumeric Offer ID; optional Store ID for listing checks; optional reason code for targeted unpublish validation

diagnostics.purpose: Deterministic OL triage engine: OL API → matched rules → concurrent fact resolution → boolean rule evaluation
Render the TriageResult into a human-readable Markdown report (read-only)
Run all applicable unpublish reason-code validators against live catalog data

supported_reason_codes.description: Offer end date has passed
Offer has not yet reached its start date
No active price set for the offer
Missing logistics / shipping data
No active distribution center assigned
Missing item dimensions
Product name / title is missing
Primary product image is missing
1P firearms compliance flag triggered
1P sales unit of measure is missing
Shipping information is missing
Gift card min/max price not set
Tax code is not assigned to the offer
One or more bundle component offers are unpublished
Product is not in active state
Offer was deleted via OPS operation
Offer was force-unpublished
Item is flagged as goods not for resale
Offer has no sellable national inventory
1P offer missing is_alcoholic_beverage product attribute

all: all results.status in ['Valid ✅', 'No review required ✅', 'Validator not yet implemented 🚧']

runbooks.name: Offer is currently LISTED
runbooks.description: OL API reports the offer is currently LISTED at this store. No delist condition to verify; close as healthy.

runbooks.name: DELISTED — all matched rules VALID
runbooks.description: Every matched delist rule evaluated to VALID against the resolved facts. The delist is correct; no action needed.

runbooks.name: DELISTED — at least one rule INVALID (wrongful delist)
runbooks.description: At least one matched delist rule evaluated to INVALID. The delist appears wrongful and should be reviewed by the catalog team.

runbooks.name: DELISTED — partial evaluation
runbooks.description: At least one rule could not be fully evaluated because an unsupported field gated the result. Surface the partially evaluated rule(s) for human review.

runbooks.name: Cannot evaluate — all required fields unsupported
runbooks.description: All required fields for the matched rules are currently unsupported by the triage engine. Manual review is required.

runbooks.name: Offer is PUBLISHED — no unpublish validation required
runbooks.description: Offer is currently in PUBLISHED state. No suppression active; no investigation needed.

runbooks.name: All reason codes correctly applied — offer correctly unpublished
runbooks.description: All detected unpublish reason codes have been validated and are correctly applied.

actions.description: Log validation outcome for audit trail. No corrective action required.

runbooks.name: Offer wrongly unpublished — at least one invalid reason code
runbooks.description: At least one unpublish reason code is not justified by current catalog data.

actions.description: Review invalid reason codes identified by the validator.
Initiate corrective action to re-publish offer after root-cause fix.

runbooks.name: Manual review required — insufficient data for automated verdict
runbooks.description: API failures or missing data prevented an automated verdict for one or more reason codes.

actions.description: Manually inspect the offer and relevant catalog APIs.
Re-run validation once API issues are resolved.

tools.description: Comprehensive offer unpublish validator — runs all 20 reason-code validators against live APIs
Map combined outcomes to runbook card

permitted_actions: Read-only Uber Mappings / Uber Keys lookup
Recommendation output only — no catalog writes
denied_actions: Mutating product, price, or inventory data
Triggering any write to upstream systems
